explication: Frappe Helpdesk is a customer-support system with an agent desk and customer portal. The main workflow is submitting or finding a ticket, agent handling and communication, then tracking response and resolution against policy. The repository also documents knowledge-base search, assignment rules, saved replies, and analytics. The graph preserves these product stages and major capabilities; many backend feature files are listed but unsampled, so their internal call relationships are not asserted.
